body:
I just want to add this to the combination experience log so other ravers can see the benefits of after-roll vicodin.  After spending six hours at a rave and ingesting 2.5 pills of pure mdma, I was fairly amped up by the time I got home.  My muscles were sore from dancing and I was overly-exhausted from being up all night.  I decided to pop 5mg of vicodin.  It totally chilled me out and very much complemented my euphoria. No negative side effects to this combination and upon further research I found that in my opinion there are no known negative effects to combining mdma and vicodin like I did.
